2607.28418.title: WIDE: Boosting Adaptive LLM Inference via Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning
2607.28418.paper_summary: Pruning is a promising approach for improving the efficiency of LLMs. Existing static structured pruning methods are hardware-friendly and can deliver practical throughput gains, but their input-agnostic computation allocation often causes substantial accuracy degradation under aggressive sparsity. Recent dynamic sparsity methods improve quality retention by adapting computation to individual inputs, yet they remain largely limited to coarse-grained structural decisions and their practical acceleration under real-world inference scenarios remains challenging. To address these challenges, we present WIDE, the first end-to-end differentiable token-level dynamic width pruning framework designed for both prefill and decode scenarios. WIDE enables fine-grained computation allocation by allowing each token to dynamically select attention-head groups and FFN-channel groups, extending dynamic pruning beyond layer-level decisions to neuron-block-level granularity. Through a two-stage training pipeline, WIDE learns effective token-wise sparse execution patterns and achieves substantially better quality retention than existing approaches. To make such fine-grained dynamic pruning practical, we further propose a pruning--kernel co-design framework that decomposes dynamic sparsity acceleration into mask reordering, hardware-agnostic block-level skipping, and hardware-dependent intra-block skipping, enabling efficient execution across different granularities. At 50% sparsity, WIDE provides 55.1% performance boost when compared to the state-of-the-art dynamic depth pruning under calibration-only settings. Under prefill and decoding inference workloads, WIDE achieves close-to-theoretical kernel-level speedups of up to 1.98x for prefill and 4.95x for decoding, as well as 1.68x and 1.55x end-to-end acceleration. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE.
2607.28418.paper_summary_zh: 修剪是一種有前景的方法，用於提高大型語言模型（LLMs）的效率。現有的靜態結構修剪方法對硬體友好，並且可以提供實際的吞吐量增益，但它們對輸入無關的計算分配往往會在激進的稀疏性下導致顯著的準確性下降。最近的動態稀疏性方法通過根據個別輸入調整計算來改善質量保留，但它們在很大程度上仍然限於粗粒度的結構決策，並且在現實推理場景下的實際加速仍然具有挑戰性。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了WIDE，這是第一個端到端可微分的標記級動態寬度修剪框架，旨在用於填充和解碼場景。WIDE通過允許每個標記動態選擇注意力頭組和FFN通道組來實現細粒度的計算分配，將動態修剪擴展到超越層級決策的神經元區塊級粒度。通過兩階段的訓練流程，WIDE學習有效的標記級稀疏執行模式，並且在質量保留方面顯著優於現有方法。為了使這種細粒度的動態修剪變得實用，我們進一步提出了一個修剪-內核協同設計框架，將動態稀疏加速分解為掩碼重排序、硬體無關的區塊級跳過和硬體依賴的區塊內跳過，從而實現跨不同粒度的高效執行。在50%的稀疏性下，WIDE在僅進行校準的情況下，與最先進的動態深度修剪相比，提供了55.1%的性能提升。在填充和解碼推理工作負載下，WIDE實現了接近理論內核級的加速，填充達到1.98倍，解碼達到4.95倍，以及1.68倍和1.55倍的端到端加速。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/EIT-NLP/LLM-Pruning/tree/main/WIDE 獲得。
